messages.subject: Rattle 2.3.20
parts:
Hello Everyone,

Have you seen that Rattle is not up to Version 2.3.20.

There have been some big changes in recent times, and I was wondering
how people have been dealing with the speed and complexity of the
changes.

I was also wondering if anyone has found some interesting datasets to
usage in the public domain.

Regards
Tony

messages.author: 417c48537bd6740c
messages.subject: Re: Rattle 2.3.20
parts:
Hi Tony:
I'm actually very happy with the changes. An entire section of the
program that was not available (prediction of continuous variables) is
now available. Neural networks have added.

As for your second question, a good starting point is :

http://www.kdnuggets.com/

They have a section on Dataset freely available. Actually this was the
page where I found out about Rattle.

Good luck,

Ernesto
